newsitem.title: USA: InnovaCom to buy Antenna Technology.
newsitem.headline: InnovaCom to buy Antenna Technology.

text.p: InnovaCom Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to aquire privately held Antenna Technology Communications for an undisclosed amount of cash and stock.
The Arizona-based Antenna designs and makes satellite systems for business, government, military and educational applications, and its 1996 sales would approach $5 million, InnovaCom said.
InnovaCom, which designs, develops and manufactures advanced semiconductor products for video and communications, said it planned to complete the deal within the next 30 days.
